title: Renewal, Upgrade and Downgrade Settings of Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions
content:
Each Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product carries five settings for renewal and for moving to another subscription during the term: whether a new subscription renews automatically, the price charged at renewal, whether an upgrade to a higher subscription is allowed during the term, what credit the current price earns on an upgrade, and whether a downgrade is allowed before the term ends.

| Subscription | New subscription renews automatically | Price charged at renewal | Upgrade during the term | Credit for the current price on an upgrade | Downgrade before the term ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | Yes | Current list price | Allowed | Prorated over the remaining months | Not allowed |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | Yes | Current list price | Allowed | Prorated over the remaining months | Not allowed |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | Yes | Current list price | Allowed | Prorated over the remaining months | Not allowed |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | Yes | Current list price | Allowed | Prorated over the remaining months | Not allowed |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | Yes | Current list price | Allowed | Prorated over the remaining months | Not allowed |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | Yes | Current list price | Not allowed | None | Not allowed |

## Per-subscription reading

- Every subscription starts with automatic renewal switched on, and every renewal is charged at the current list price.
- Five subscriptions allow an upgrade during the term, with the current price credited prorated over the remaining months. Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network allows no upgrade, and its credit setting is None.
- No subscription allows a downgrade before the term ends.
